text.A: **Ta politika velja, kjer koli ste.** Upoštevamo zakonodajo Združenega kraljestva o varstvu podatkov, kadar pa se uporablja tudi zakonodaja o varstvu podatkov države, v kateri živite, upoštevamo tudi to.
text.B: **Opombe o alergijah in prehrani.** Skupaj z naročilom jih posredujemo food trucku in jih za nič drugega ne uporabljamo. Odstranimo jih, skupaj z vašim imenom in kontaktnimi podatki, 12 mesecev po naročilu (glejte razdelek 7).
text.C: **Mednarodni prenosi.** Podatki vašega računa in podatki o naročilih se shranjujejo in obdelujejo v Združenem kraljestvu. Nekatere stvari se obdelujejo zunaj njega: izluščanje jedilnikov in samodejni odgovori WhatsApp, ki uporabljajo Googlovo storitev v Združenih državah Amerike; dostava sporočil WhatsApp, ki jo izvaja Meta v Združenih državah Amerike; plačila, ki jih izvaja Stripe v Združenih državah Amerike; in potisna obvestila, ki jih dostavljata Apple in Google v Združenih državah Amerike. Kadar podatki zapustijo Združeno kraljestvo, je prenos zajet v predpisih Združenega kraljestva o ustreznosti ali v International Data Transfer Agreement (sporazum o mednarodnem prenosu podatkov) ali Addendum (dodatek), kadar pa to zahteva pravo vaše države, tudi z zaščitnim ukrepom, ki ga to pravo priznava. Za podrobnosti o zaščitnih ukrepih, ki se uporabljajo, nas lahko vprašate.
text.G:
Naši [Pogoji storitve](/terms) veljajo v vseh državah, v katerih se uporablja HatchGrab. Nekatere države imajo dodatna pravila. Ta stran jih navaja, za vsako državo posebej.

Kadar za vas velja kateri od spodnjih razdelkov, je del naših Pogojev storitve. Če določa kaj drugega kot ti pogoji, za to državo velja ta stran.

Če vaše države ni na seznamu, dodatnih pravil ni: Pogoji storitve veljajo, kot so zapisani. Naša [Politika zasebnosti](/privacy) je enaka v vseh državah.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you are.** We comply with UK data protection legislation, and where the data protection legislation of the country you live in also applies, we comply with that too.
back.B: **Notes on allergies and diet.** We pass them to the food truck together with the order and use them for nothing else. We remove them, together with your name and contact details, 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: ...or Addendum (addendum), and where the law of your country requires it, also by a safeguard that this law recognises.
back.D: Intro: In accordance with UK data protection legislation and with the law of the country you live in, where it applies, you have the right to: [bullets unchanged]. / The law of the country you live in may give you these rights under other names or give you additional rights. You have these too. / **Making a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before we act, we will check whether the request is genuine. You can ask someone to submit the request for you, and we will not treat you differently for submitting a request. We will reply within one month or sooner if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request to that food truck, because it decides how your order details are used. If we reject a request, you can ask us to review it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [unchanged] + When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only when the law of the country you live in allows it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each one states who it is from, includes our postal address and tells you how to stop receiving such messages. If you ask us to stop, we will stop, free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order notifications by SMS, you will receive them only if you agree, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach concerning your personal data is likely to cause you serious harm, we will notify you and the supervisory authority as soon as possible where the law requires it, or we will help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** First write to us at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would appreciate the opportunity to put things right. You can also complain to the data protection authority in the country you live in. In the UK, that is the Information Commissioner's Office (British Information Commissioner), at ico.org.uk or on telephone number 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service] apply in all countries where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have additional rules. This page sets them out, for each country separately. / Where one of the sections below applies to you, it forms part of our Terms of Service. If it provides something different from these terms, this page applies for that country. / If your country is not on the list, there are no additional rules: the Terms of Service apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy] is the same in all countries.
